notes.title: update alpha 1.0
notes.content:
1. Zombie now have stamina meter, starting at 100%.
2. At stamina 40%, zombie will look for place to rest.
3. Zombie will look for bed and rest at the bed. 
4. Player can choose to purchase weapon from the zombie vendor by increasing quantity, and then purchase the weapon.
5. Pressing ‘P’ will buy potion for $2, and restore stamina of zombie with the lowest stamina under 40%. When no zombie with stamina under 40, potion will not be bought.
6. Pressing zombie with stamina under 100 will make them go to rest. Pressing them again will make them return to work, if their stamina is already under 40.
7. Weapon will automatically be equipped by zombie.
8. Zombie with weapon have stronger attack power

see you on the next update
Kessels game studio
